approx_multiplier.name: Pentium-Style Approximate Multiplier
approx_multiplier.description: Subtle corner-case multiplier failure: When rs1 nibble [11:8]==4'h9 and rs2 nibble [7:4]==4'hC, bit 5 of the 32-bit product is inverted. Exact on 99.9% of arithmetic inputs.
approx_multiplier.line_marker: assign pcpi_rd = shift_out ? (EXTRA_MUL_FFS ? rd_q : rd) >> 32 : (EXTRA_MUL_FFS ? rd_q : rd);
approx_multiplier.replacement: assign pcpi_rd = (shift_out ? (EXTRA_MUL_FFS ? rd_q : rd) >> 32 : (EXTRA_MUL_FFS ? rd_q : rd)) ^ (((rs1[11:8] == 4'h9) && (rs2[7:4] == 4'hc)) ? 32'h00000020 : 32'h0);
approx_multiplier.expected_symptom: Mismatch on rd_wdata during MUL/MULH for targeted operand pairs (e.g., rs1=0x900, rs2=0x0c0).

alu_operator_xor_or.name: ALU Operator Mutation (XOR -> OR)
alu_operator_xor_or.description: Mutates bitwise XOR to bitwise OR when reg_op2 is a negative immediate (reg_op2[31] == 1).
alu_operator_xor_or.expected_symptom: Mismatch on rd_wdata for XORI/XOR with sign-extended negative immediates.

branch_inversion_blt.name: Branch Signed Comparison Inversion
branch_inversion_blt.description: Inverts signed BLT/BGE comparison when comparing negative boundary operands with positive operands (signed overflow edge case).
branch_inversion_blt.expected_symptom: Control-flow divergence (pc_wdata mismatch) on BLT when rs1 is negative and rs2 is non-negative.

writeback_forwarding_drop.name: Register Writeback Hazard Drop
writeback_forwarding_drop.description: Drops register writeback to destination register x5 when immediately followed by instruction reading x5.
writeback_forwarding_drop.expected_symptom: Stale register value read from x5 on back-to-back dependency chain.

mem_handshake_drop.name: Memory Handshake Protocol Drop
mem_handshake_drop.description: Memory controller drops write strobe ack and stalls when writing unaligned halfwords back-to-back.
mem_handshake_drop.expected_symptom: Uncompleted memory write transfer or dropped mem_wstrb on unaligned 16-bit halfword stores.
